question_text: Construct bookings_on(self, day) in Python. self.bookings is a list whose first self.used entries are booking objects; later entries may be None. Each booking has a start_day string in YYYY-MM-DD format. Return a new list of all active bookings starting on day, in stored order.

verification.test_code:
def bookings_on(self, day):
    result = []
    for i in range(self.used):
        booking = self.bookings[i]
        if booking.start_day == day:
            result.append(booking)
    return result
